{
  "dataset_name": "phoneme",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V1 to V2, smoothed by adding 1.0 to the absolute value of V2 to prevent division by zero.",
      "value_range": [-1.7, 3.78],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized relative measure between the first two features, helping linear models capture interaction effects without complex non-linear kernels.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / (np.abs(V2) + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_v4_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between V3 and V4.",
      "value_range": [-3.69, 4.3],
      "feature_family": "difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a direct linear projection of the contrast between V3 and V4, which is highly suitable for linear SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 - V4"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_v3_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of the first three features, emphasizing V1.",
      "value_range": [-1.48, 3.57],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates the primary features into a single continuous severity measure, reducing dimensionality and noise for the linear classifier.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.5 * V1 + 0.3 * V2 + 0.2 * V3"
    },
    {
      "name": "v4_v5_magnitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean-like magnitude of the higher-index features V4 and V5.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.43],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the combined intensity of V4 and V5 in a non-linear way, exposing a new linearly separable boundary based on magnitude.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(V4**2 + V5**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_max",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The maximum value between V1 and V2.",
      "value_range": [-1.28, 3.78],
      "feature_family": "logical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Extracts the dominant signal between the first two features, providing a piecewise linear feature useful for margin boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(V1, V2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_min",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The minimum value between V1 and V2.",
      "value_range": [-1.7, 3.57],
      "feature_family": "logical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Extracts the baseline or weaker signal between the first two features, complementing the maximum feature for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.minimum(V1, V2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "global_mean_value",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The average value across all five features.",
      "value_range": [-1.32, 3.05],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a global continuous measure of the row's overall magnitude, serving as a stable baseline feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 + V2 + V3 + V4 + V5) / 5.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v5_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between the first and last features.",
      "value_range": [-4.08, 4.92],
      "feature_family": "difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the spread or contrast between the extremes of the feature set, offering a strong linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 - V5"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_energy_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of the squares of all five features.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 48.05],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Represents the total variance or energy of the observation, allowing the linear SVM to separate based on overall intensity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1**2 + V2**2 + V3**2 + V4**2 + V5**2"
    },
    {
      "name": "spectral_tilt_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the energy in V4 and V5 to the energy in V1 and V2, smoothed by 1.0.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 11.75],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures the balance between higher-index and lower-index feature energies, providing a normalized continuous score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V4**2 + V5**2) / (V1**2 + V2**2 + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_v3_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V2 to V3, smoothed by adding 1.0 to the absolute value of V3.",
      "value_range": [-1.28, 3.57],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the relative proportion between V2 and V3, useful for identifying specific patterns in the middle features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V2 / (np.abs(V3) + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "acoustic_signal_complexity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of the acoustic signal's complexity based on the distribution and magnitude of the 5 features, returning a continuous score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures holistic properties of the signal that might not be easily expressed through simple arithmetic combinations, providing a linearly separable feature for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
